guarantees.claim: unused_clk is always driven to the value of clk_i.
unused_rst is always driven to the value of rst_ni.

assumptions.claim: clk_i and rst_ni must be driven with valid clock and reset values by the enclosing environment.
assumptions.risk: If undriven or invalid, unused_clk/unused_rst become X, potentially causing metastability or unexpected behavior if those signals are actually used elsewhere.

uncertain_points.claim: unused_clk and unused_rst may be dead signals, present only to suppress lint warnings. It is unclear whether they are actually read inside the gen_sec_buf generate block (line 38) or elsewhere.
uncertain_points.cond: if gen_sec_buf does not reference unused_clk or unused_rst
uncertain_points.risk: If genuinely unused, they add pointless logic; if used, they may serve as unintended clock/reset paths.
